data.headline: Black Friday: knock out the Thanksgiving bloat with Fiber Uppercut
data.image_alt: A tub of Fiber Uppercut next to Thanksgiving leftovers and a glass of water

data.heading: The feast is over. Your gut comeback starts now
data.body:
Thanksgiving cleared the plate, and now it's time to clear things out. Fiber Uppercut is a once-a-day powder that mixes into water, smoothies or coffee in seconds. Citrus-peach flavor, no grit, no gluten.

Mix one scoop with 8 oz of liquid. Stir, sip, done. Grab it before the Black Friday sale ends.

Try it for $10.
